sentences.la: Ita cantat colōnus ut omnēs accurrant.
sentences.en: The farmer sings in such a way that all run up.

sentences.la: Ursus tam celeriter currit ut nēmō eum videat.
sentences.en: Ursus runs so quickly that nobody sees him.

sentences.la: Gubernātor tam fessus est ut nōn ambulet.
sentences.en: The helmsman is so tired that he does not walk.

sentences.la: Cīvis tam aeger erat ut statim iacēret.
sentences.en: The citizen was so sick that he lay down at once.

sentences.la: Iānitōrēs tam miserī sunt ut nōn rīdeant.
sentences.en: The doorkeepers are so unhappy that they do not laugh.

sentences.la: Erus tam aeger est ut statim cubet.
sentences.en: The master is so sick that he lies down at once.

sentences.la: Marītus tam trīstis est ut plōret.
sentences.en: The husband is so sad that he cries.

sentences.la: Dominus tam ferōx est ut mīlitēs plōrent.
sentences.en: The owner is so fierce that the soldiers cry.

sentences.la: Tantus est metus ut incolae fugiant.
sentences.en: So great is the fear that the inhabitants flee.

sentences.la: Ita cantat nūntius ut omnēs veniant.
sentences.en: The messenger sings in such a way that all come.
